# montecarlo_gcp_dataform_credentials (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `locations` (List of String) Google Cloud regions to read Dataform repositories in, such as us-central1.
- `project_id` (String) Google Cloud project that holds the Dataform repositories.
- `service_account_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The service account's JSON key file, as its text. It needs Dataform API access. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `service_account_key_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `service_account_key_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.

### Read-Only

- `client_email` (String) Email address of the service account.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
